text: SAAS Properties is a family-owned UAE property developer, founded in 2019 by Chairman Mohammad Bin Ahmad Bin Saeed Al Qassimi and his son, CEO Ahmed Al Qassimi.
short: SAAS Properties is a family-owned UAE developer founded by the Al Qassimi father and son.
